responsibility: Defines regression tests for the lev_distance module’s string-similarity utilities, verifying Unicode-aware edit-distance behavior, limit-based early rejection, substring-aware scoring, and best-name suggestion selection used for symbol matching.
same_name_distinction: This `tests.rs` is the string-similarity test file, focused on Levenshtein distance, thresholded rejection, substring-aware scoring, and best-match name suggestion. Unlike `symbol/tests.rs`, it uses interned symbols only as inputs to suggestion logic, not to verify interner identity or identifier semantics.
